en-US.name: Ambient
en-US.summary: Ambient makes the phone call you do not want to make.
en-US.description: Ask Ambient to call a business. It talks to a person, checks with you before agreeing to spend, and tells you what was confirmed.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Ambient to call Joe's Plumbing
Alexa, ask Ambient how's the call going
Alexa, tell Ambient offer one sixty
